create_boxohack_env: create a BoxoHack environment instance with custom level set and reward shaping coefficient
load_boxoban_levels: load Boxoban level files from a directory path and return parsed level strings
get_env_map: parse a Boxoban level string into a map and extract boulder fountain and player positions
get_lvl_gen: generate a random LevelGenerator from available Boxoban levels with boulders and fountains placed
register_boxoban_envs: register MiniHack-Boxoban-Unfiltered-Medium and Hard environment variants with the gym registry
